params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: rowPosition
params.description: Position at which the new row(s) are inserted.

overloads.semanticRole: Inserts one or more new rows at the given position in an array-based list box, extending all of the list box's column arrays.

constraints: Only works with array-based list boxes; on a selection/entity-selection or collection list box it does nothing and sets OK to 0.
